visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with a shaved head, wearing a light grey traditional monk's robe and a long necklace of dark wooden prayer beads, sits at a light-colored wooden table. On the table sits a clear glass of water and a red-covered book. The background is a dimly lit indoor room with cream-colored curtains and a floor lamp providing warm light. He speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial movements. (2) The scene shifts to a coastal landscape under a bright, overcast sky. Green moss-covered rocks are scattered along the shoreline in the foreground, with turquoise ocean waves crashing against them and creating white sea foam. In the distance, a hazy coastline with buildings is visible under a blue-grey sky. (3) A young woman is shown in profile, silhouetted against a bright, hazy sunset over the ocean. She is wearing a floral-patterned bikini and large sunglasses, her hair flowing as she walks slowly along the beach. The lighting is golden and high-contrast, emphasizing her silhouette and the shimmering water in the background. (4) The man in the monk's robe is now walking along a vast, sandy beach under a cloudy sky. He holds a string of prayer beads in his hands, moving them as if praying. In the background, large, mist-shrouded mountains rise behind the shoreline, and the ocean waves roll gently onto the dark sand. Multiple superimposed images of him are edited together to create a montage effect. (5) Returning to the indoor setting, the man laughs uncontrollably, covering his mouth with his hand. He gestures towards the camera, his face reddened from laughter. The framing is a medium shot, centered on him at the table with the same glass of water and red book. (6) A series of exterior shots show an aerial view of a small town with a river running through it, followed by a street scene with buildings and people on a motorcycle. A large, grey and white bird with a long beak is then shown wading in a shallow, grassy marsh, pecking at the ground in search of food. (7) The man is now at a snowy ski resort, wearing his grey monk's robe over warm clothing, along with a ski helmet and goggles. He waves to the camera and then snowboards down a groomed slope. A montage follows, showing various people in colorful ski gear falling on the snow in comedic ways, interspersed with shots of him praying on the mountain. (8) Professional ski instructors in black and blue uniforms are shown teaching students on the slopes. The DBC logo appears prominently on the screen. The man in the monk's robe is seen practicing with an instructor, giving a thumbs-up and pointing to himself. The lighting is bright and natural for a snowy outdoor environment. (9) Back at the table, a white landline telephone rings. The man answers it, holding the receiver to his ear. His expression shifts from serious to surprised and then to a conspiratorial smile as he talks. Subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen throughout the conversation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a calm, male voice speaking Mandarin with a clear, professional tone. A gentle, mid-tempo background music featuring acoustic guitar and soft synth pads plays at a low volume. The ambient sound is that of a quiet indoor room with a clean, studio-like noise floor. (2) A transition occurs with the distinct, broadband sound of ocean waves crashing and rushing water, exhibiting high spectral bandwidth. The male voice continues its narration over this ambient layer, maintaining a moderate speech rate and conversational pitch variability. (3) The acoustic music persists as the speaker's voice becomes more animated. A sudden burst of high-pitched, rhythmic laughter (high arousal, positive valence) breaks the narrative flow. The laughter is natural, with audible breathiness and a wide dynamic range, followed by a slight coughing sound. (4) The background atmosphere shifts to an outdoor setting with the muffled sounds of motorcycle engines and distant city chatter. This is followed by the naturalistic sounds of a bird pecking in water, characterized by short, percussive splashing transients. (5) The BGM transitions into a high-energy, upbeat electronic pop track with a strong, driving beat (approx. 128 BPM). Sharp SFX of snow being carved by skis (hissing white noise) and percussive thud sounds (low-frequency impacts) are layered in during the skiing montage. The male speaker's tone becomes more enthusiastic and promotional. (6) A loud, rhythmic ring-ring sound of a traditional landline telephone (high-pitched electronic pulses) interrupts the music. The music fades out, leaving only the male voice. The speaker answers with a polite 'Wei?' and engages in a dialogue, with his voice showing high pitch variability and a mix of surprise and excitement. The phase ends with a sharp, mechanical click as the phone receiver is hung up.
